description: Land Title Settlement Department - Jayagampura, Medirigiriya D/S Division, Polonnaruwa District - Cad. Map No. 120062 and others
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including their numbers, extents, ownership details (all listed as "The State"), and classification. The content falls under "Land and property-related matters" including "land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) classification criteria.
